title: Design System: SOLARA Atlas Employee Portal

display.purpose: Primary page headings such as My leave.

shadows.name: portal-panel
shadows.purpose: Lift white workspace, request, service, form, and list panels from the pale teal ground.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Give the filled leave action a restrained action cue.

motion.name: action-state

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Filled action for requesting leave or submitting a Comp Off decision; home actions reduce to 48px minimum height at mobile widths.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #006b64; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 107, 100, 0.18); font: 730 0.94rem InterVar, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00544f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b8178; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #d3e4e1; color: #486660; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 6px; font-size: 0.76rem; line-height: 1.25; text-align: center; } }

components.name: Secondary Leave Action
components.description: Outlined action for requesting earned Comp Off credit; it pairs with the leave action at mobile widths.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 50px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #006b64; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #006b64; font: 730 0.94rem InterVar, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eaf4f2; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b8178; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 6px; font-size: 0.76rem; line-height: 1.25; text-align: center; } }

components.name: Leave Balance Tile

components.css: .ds-balance-tile { padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #c9deda; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #172f35; font-family: InterVar, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-balance-icon { display: block; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #006b64; } .ds-balance-name { margin: 0; color: #172f35; font-size: 0.88rem; } .ds-balance-value { margin: 10px 0 5px; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-balance-value span { color: #547076; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-balance-detail { margin: 0; color: #547076; font-size: 0.78rem; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-balance-tile { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 8px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-balance-icon { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / 4; width: 28px; height: 28px; margin: 0; padding: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #eaf4f2; } .ds-balance-name { grid-column: 2; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-balance-value { grid-column: 2; margin: 3px 0 2px; font-size: 1.45rem; } .ds-balance-value span { font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-balance-detail { grid-column: 2; font-size: 0.64rem; } }

components.name: Request Status
components.description: Text-bearing status chip for approved, pending, or rejected requests.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font: 760 0.7rem/1.2 InterVar, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-pending { background: #fff4d2; color: #805b00; } .ds-status-approved { background: #ddf4eb; color: #086b4e; } .ds-status-rejected { background: #fde7e2; color: #9b3323; }

components.name: Comp Off Field
components.description: Native Comp Off select or textarea control with the portal focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #172f35; font: 720 0.88rem InterVar, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field textarea { min-height: 88px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #c9deda; border-radius: 10px; color: #172f35; font: 400 0.94rem/1.45 InterVar, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-field textarea::placeholder { color: #586c70; opacity: 1; } .ds-field textarea:focus { border-color: #006b64; outline: 2px solid #b9ddd8; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Portal Tab Bar
components.description: Persistent five-destination portal navigation with a teal active state.
components.html: HomeAttendanceLeavesExpensesSalary
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); min-height: 70px; padding: 7px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #c9deda; background: #ffffff; font-family: InterVar, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: grid; place-items: center; color: #547076; font-size: 0.72rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #006b64; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b8178; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-tab-active { color: #006b64; font-weight: 720; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #006b64; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-tabs { min-height: 60px; } }

narrative.overview: SOLARA Atlas is a calm operating surface built around the employee's available leave and next action. A deep teal header and actions establish the working context; a pale teal ground and white, lightly lifted panels keep data readable without decorative imagery. At mobile widths, the system becomes denser without hiding leave allocation or splitting request data: horizontal balance cells retain their allocation lines, paired actions remain 48px targets, and the latest leave and Comp Off records appear in one summary from their existing APIs. Previews use synthetic fixture data; implementation always renders live portal data and never copies fixture values or raster content.
keyCharacteristics: Deep teal is reserved for portal chrome, primary action, active navigation, and purposeful links.
White panels group real work; fine rules and modest ambient shadow separate them from the pale ground.
Leave, earned Comp Off credit, request status, and manager responsibility stay explicit.
No separate logo symbol, imagery, charts, gradients, or decorative illustration are part of this system.

rules.name: The Teal Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use #006b64 for navigation, a primary action, or an intentional link; do not spread it across passive panel fill or routine body text.

rules.name: The Numbers Read First Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals and the heavier balance-value treatment for leave amounts; keep allocation and date detail muted and smaller.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: Apply the ambient panel shadow once to a surface; nested content stays flat or uses a fine rule.

dos: Do use the implemented #006b64, #eaf4f2, white, and #172f35 portal palette for home and Comp Off surfaces.
Do preserve real employee data, real request status, feature gates, and existing service routes; label all preview fixtures as synthetic.
Do retain the 640px dense mobile layout: horizontal balance cells with allocation lines, paired 48px home actions, 44px request links, and the core-services disclosure.
Do use existing line icons and text brand treatment without adding a new logo symbol.
donts: Don't copy raster comp text, balances, dates, counts, avatars, or other preview fixtures into the implementation.
Don't add decorative imagery, fake charts, gradients, or a new logo symbol.
Don't use the stale default Ionic gray/blue theme for these portal surfaces when the implemented portal tokens provide the relevant surface.
